notes.text: The frozen cross-reference reads כעורם; the provenance OCR has סעורם.

The saved local V42 notice headed רב סעורם (או שעורים) אחוה דרבא and the named Davidson Bava Metzia 73b paragraph with רב סעורם אחוה דרבא supply a candidate comparison for provenance סעורם. They do not settle the frozen pointer כעורם or establish its printed glyphs or correction history. No target identity is admitted.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume III, printed p. 1230, reads רב שעורם. ערך רב סעורם. The frozen transcription instead has כעורם, retained in the English with its Hebrew spelling; the vocalized transliterations are provisional. The named Bava Metzia 73b passage and the separately preserved local notice supply the Se’orim comparison mentioned in the earlier note. This source comparison does not import that notice’s biography or establish an authority identity. The earlier uncertainty about Hyman’s pointer glyph predates this printed-page inspection. The displayed heading retains the existing catalog label רב שעורם.
